==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''May 4th - May 8th, 2016''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 10 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 4th place will play the Playoffs
* '''Playoffs''' - ''May 13th - May 15th, 2016''
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
